description: This file defines the TasksController class which handles HTTP API endpoints for managing maintenance tasks in a preventive maintenance system. It includes actions for CRUD operations: creating, retrieving (all and by ID), updating, and deleting tasks, interacting with the database via Entity Framework.

classes.name: TasksController
classes.description: Controller class providing RESTful API endpoints for managing 'MaintenanceTask' entities, with actions for retrieving all, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting tasks.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a list of maintenance tasks, optionally filtered by status and asset ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single maintenance task by its ID; returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new maintenance task, setting default values for status and priority if not provided.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing maintenance task identified by ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a maintenance task by ID.
